name: Grow Therapy vs Headway
title: Grow Therapy vs Headway: Free Credentialing Platforms Compared
description: Compare Grow Therapy and Headway - two free insurance credentialing platforms for therapists. See credentialing speed, payment schedules, features, and which network fits your practice.

summary.bottom_line: Both Grow Therapy and Headway are free for therapists and use revenue-sharing models. Grow Therapy credentials fastest (5-7 days vs 2-4 weeks), includes EHR and AI documentation, and offers guaranteed claims. Headway has the largest network (70,000+ vs 19,000+), unique clawback protection, and SOC 2 certification. Both pay weekly (Grow) or bi-weekly (Headway).

key_differences.ehr_features: Grow: Included (EHR + AI docs) | Headway: None
key_differences.protection: Grow: Guaranteed claims | Headway: Clawback protection

sections.heading: Two Free Paths to Insurance
sections.content: Grow Therapy and Headway are the two leading free insurance credentialing platforms for mental health therapists. Both handle credentialing and billing without monthly fees, instead taking a percentage of insurance reimbursements. Grow Therapy differentiates with speed (5-7 day credentialing) and included practice tools. Headway differentiates with scale (largest network) and unique clawback protection.

sections.heading: Revenue Share Models
sections.content: Neither platform charges monthly fees. Both retain a percentage of insurance reimbursements as their fee. Grow Therapy doesn't provide full transparency on exact insurer-to-Grow reimbursement amounts. Headway similarly takes a share but guarantees payment even when claims are denied. For therapists, the effective rate depends on your payer mix and location.

sections.heading: Platform Tools
sections.content: Grow Therapy includes comprehensive practice management: EHR, scheduling, secure messaging, telehealth, and AI-assisted documentation - all at no additional cost. Headway focuses purely on credentialing and billing; you'll need your own EHR (SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, etc.). If you already have tools you love, Headway keeps things simple. If you want everything bundled, Grow delivers.

recommendations.when: You need to start seeing insurance clients fast (5-7 day credentialing) or want included practice management tools.
You want the security of clawback protection, prefer the largest network, or already have an EHR you use.
You value AI documentation features or want weekly (vs bi-weekly) payments.
You prioritize SOC 2 compliance or need access to 70,000+ providers for referrals.

faqs.q: Which credentials therapists faster - Grow or Headway?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy credentials in 5-7 days on average, one of the fastest in the industry. Headway typically takes 2-4 weeks. If speed is critical, Grow has a significant advantage.

faqs.q: Do I need my own EHR with Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: No. Grow Therapy includes EHR, scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, and AI documentation at no extra cost. With Headway, you need your own EHR system.

Headway guarantees payment even if claims are denied, charges disputed, or clients don't pay. Grow Therapy offers 'guaranteed claims' but the specific protections differ - check terms with each platform.

Rates vary by payer, credentials, and location. Grow reports $60-160+/session (PMHNPs average $129/hr, LCSWs $85-100/session). Neither platform publishes transparent rate comparisons vs direct credentialing.
